question_en: Which 10 Pixar films made the most money?
question_fr: Quels sont les 10 films Pixar qui ont rapporté le plus d'argent ?
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COMPANY ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COMPANY.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_COMPANY ON T_WC_T2S_COMPANY.ID_COMPANY = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COMPANY.ID_COMPANY WHERE T_WC_T2S_COMPANY.COMPANY_NAME = 'Pixar' ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.REVENUE DESC LIMIT 8
